content.title: Palisade reports outcomes from Phase Ib ulcerative colitis study
content.summary: Outcomes from the Phase Ib cohort included a mean decrease of 62.8% in the modified Mayo score.

thumbnail.caption: The company plans to conclude a Phase Ib trial in those with fibrostenotic Crohn’s disease by the second half of this year. Credit: Tualek Photographer / Shutterstock.com.
